title: Late Charge Schedule for Construction Loans Interest Bills
content:
A late charge on a Construction Loans interest bill is a percentage of the unpaid interest, held between a minimum and a maximum dollar amount, and arises only once a grace period of calendar days after the due date has run. Each product also allows a set number of courtesy waivers per loan in any rolling 12 months.

| Product | Late charge, % of the unpaid interest | Minimum late charge | Maximum late charge | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Courtesy waivers per loan per rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 5 | USD 25 | USD 250 | 15 | 1 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 5 | USD 25 | USD 250 | 15 | 1 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 5 | USD 25 | USD 250 | 15 | 1 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 5 | USD 25 | USD 250 | 15 | 1 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 5 | USD 35 | USD 500 | 15 | 1 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 4 | USD 50 | USD 1000 | 10 | 0 |

## Definitions

- **Late charge percentage** — Late charge on an interest bill unpaid after grace, % of the unpaid interest.
- **Minimum late charge** — Minimum late charge, USD.
- **Maximum late charge** — Maximum late charge, USD.
- **Grace period** — Calendar days after the due date before a late charge arises.
- **Courtesy waiver allowance** — Late charges waivable as a courtesy per loan per rolling 12 months.

## Notes to the schedule

1. The four home construction products share one set of late charge terms: 5 percent, at least USD 25 and at most USD 250, after a 15-day grace period, with 1 courtesy waiver per loan per rolling 12 months.
2. The Farm Building Construction Loan keeps the 5 percent rate and the 15-day grace period but bounds the charge between USD 35 and USD 500.
3. The Livestock Facility Construction Loan charges 4 percent, bounded between USD 50 and USD 1000, after a 10-day grace period, and its courtesy waiver allowance is 0 per loan per rolling 12 months.
